Full review text: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-rajmodi-Documents-5th-sem-CN-VPNTunnel--claude-worktrees-testing-strategy-linux-12bffd/305f7ba5-a6a5-443c-bfa2-0eaf2ca49e63/scratchpad/feedback/pr54.txt (read it).

PR #54, branch raj/rj4-live-reload (`git fetch origin`, start from the remote head, which already contains a merge of origin/main; if the branch is checked out elsewhere use a local branch name and `git push origin local:remote`). Fix concern 1: control/src/daemon.rs `RELOAD_REFUSALS` treats EBUSY and ENOMEM as permanent, so a reload that hits them is dropped until the file changes. Make EBUSY(16) and ENOMEM(12) TRANSIENT: keep the running configuration, log it, and retry the SAME file version after a short delay (a few seconds, bounded attempts, e.g. 3 s and at most 5 attempts, constants named and documented), then give up as rejected with a clear log line. EINVAL, ENOSPC, E2BIG, EMSGSIZE stay permanent. The Watcher must distinguish 'rejected permanently', 'retry later (version, attempts, next_at)' and 'applied', and a changed file must reset the retry state. Write unit tests (Watcher level and, if the existing reload test seam allows, reload level) for: transient then success, transient exhausted then rejected and not retried again, file changed during retry resets, permanent never retried. Update docs/CONTROLLER.md 'Live reconfiguration' accordingly. Concern 2 (clock.now() in reload) CANNOT be done in this PR because #51's BootClock is not in this branch: do NOT merge #51 here. Instead, make `reload()` take `now: Instant` as a parameter rather than calling Instant::now() itself, so that after #51 lands it is a one-line change at the call site; the loop's own Instant::now() stays. Run cargo fmt --check, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test in control/ (all must pass). Prove at least the transient-retry test fails if EBUSY is moved back to the permanent list. Report commit, changes, results, anything unverified (the tests/netns/rj4_reload.py VM run is NOT done by you).

content.text:
Concern 1 is fixed and pushed. On this Mac, though, `cargo clippy`, `cargo test` and a compile of `daemon.rs` never covered the changed code. `daemon.rs` is Linux-only here (`#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]` in `lib.rs`), so it was not compiled at all, and there is no Linux Rust target installed.

**Commit:** `2d88da7`, pushed with a normal push (`rj4-fix:raj/rj4-live-reload`, `6bc0d54..2d88da7`). It has no trailers and is authored as RAJMODI.

**What changed (`control/src/daemon.rs`, `docs/CONTROLLER.md`):**
- **Error classes:** EBUSY(16) and ENOMEM(12) moved to a new `RELOAD_TRANSIENT` list. `RELOAD_REFUSALS` now holds only E2BIG, EINVAL, ENOSPC and EMSGSIZE. A small `classify_refusal` function returns permanent, transient, or none (none still ends the session, as before).
- **Retry constants:** `RELOAD_RETRY_DELAY` is 3 s and `RELOAD_MAX_ATTEMPTS` is 5, counting the first attempt. Both are documented in the code.
- **Reload outcomes:** `reload()` can now return `Reloaded::Transient`. In the loop, that goes to `Watcher::retry_later`, which returns `Later{attempt}` or `GaveUp`. The log says "deferred (attempt n of 5, retrying in 3s)", or "rejected after 5 attempts" when it gives up.
- **Watcher:** `poll(now)` now takes the time. Retry state is a `Pending {version, attempts, next_at}`. A version waiting out a retry is offered again only once `next_at` has passed. Any changed file, `applied()` or `rejected()` clears the retry state, and giving up marks the version rejected.
- **Concern 2:** `reload(..., now: Instant)` now takes the time and passes it to `reconfigure`. The loop's own `Instant::now()` is unchanged, and I did not merge #51.
- **Docs:** the "Live reconfiguration" paragraph in `docs/CONTROLLER.md` now describes permanent and transient refusals, the 3 s delay, the 5 attempts, and the reset when the file changes.

**New tests:**
- **Classification:** EBUSY and ENOMEM are transient; EINVAL, ENOSPC, E2BIG and EMSGSIZE are permanent; other errors are none.
- **Transient then success:** not offered again before 3 s, offered again at 3 s, then applied.
- **Exhausted:** five attempts, then `GaveUp`, no further polls even after long waits, and a changed file is offered again.
- **File changed during retry:** the new content is offered at once and gets a fresh budget (attempt 1, not 5).
- **Permanent:** a rejected version is never retried.
- **Reload level:** there is no reload-level test, because `reload()` needs a live netlink `Client`. Classification is a separate pure function, so it is covered at that level.

**Results:**
- `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings` and `cargo test` on this Mac pass (107 library tests plus the integration tests), but they skip `daemon.rs`.
- To test the Watcher and classification logic, I copied them into a throwaway crate (`scratchpad/mk.py` and `scratchpad/sc_ok`, outside the repo) along with the existing and new daemon tests. All 11 pass.
- The mutation check passes. Moving EBUSY back to the permanent list makes `ebusy_and_enomem_are_transient_and_the_rest_permanent` fail (`left: Some(Permanent), right: Some(Transient)`). The other 10 tests still pass in that crate. Only the classification test catches it, because the Watcher tests call `retry_later` directly.

**Unverified:**
- Linux build, clippy and tests of `daemon.rs`, including the loop and `reload()` edits. Hosted CI or a Linux run needs to confirm them. I checked those edits by reading them: `new_bytes` is moved in each match arm, `now` is in scope at the call, and `Retry` is in the same module.
- `tests/netns/rj4_reload.py` and any real EBUSY from the kernel were not run, as instructed.
- If COMMIT hits EBUSY after VALIDATE succeeded, the retry re-runs VALIDATE with the same revision number. I assumed the kernel accepts that.
